ref.quote: SJ0-1SFC2DY-IS 2 AGENTSCHAP INTEGRATIE EN INBURGERING / SL0-1SDE2JA-WT 2 JUSTITIEHUIZEN EN ELEKTRONISCH TOEZICHT KOSTEN / SH0-1SKA2PB-WT 1 VASTGOEDBEHEER / SC0-1SJA2NY-IS 1 EIGEN VERMOGEN DIGITAAL VLAANDEREN / SA0-1SQB2WY-IS 1 TOERISME VLAANDEREN / SA0-1SPA2OY-IS 3 VLAAMS AGENTSCHAP VOOR INTERNATIONAAL ONDERNEMEN
ref.note: Very mixed line; it excludes the local government funds (separate line). A large share is the running cost of the Flemish administration's central services: staff ('apparaatskredieten'), pensions, buildings (Facilitair Bedrijf, 'VASTGOEDBEHEER') and IT (Digitaal Vlaanderen); the third phrase covers buildings and IT. Most justice-house and electronic-monitoring spending is staff of the Agentschap Justitie en Handhaving (SL0-1SAE2ZZ-LO), not the small cost article quoted; the domain also funds youth-delinquency measures (JEUGDDELINQUENTIE). FIT is the name the budget explanation itself uses for the Vlaams Agentschap voor Internationaal Ondernemen (Flanders Investment & Trade); Toerisme Vlaanderen trades as VISITFLANDERS. Other items not covered: Flemish Rand policy, cities policy, development cooperation and foreign representation. corrected: all articles confirmed at the stated pages. Flag 4: the four phrases covered only policy agencies and skipped the administration's central services, among the largest items (VASTGOEDBEHEER, Digitaal Vlaanderen, staff); merged tourism and export into one phrase and added 'buildings and IT of the Flemish government'. Flag 2: agency names dropped from the merged phrase to keep it short; the caveat names the agencies as the budget does (Toerisme Vlaanderen; FIT at vp-17 p. 100) and notes the public names (VISITFLANDERS, Flanders Investment & Trade), which are clearly the same agencies. French shortened.
